name: Energy Mutagen (Major)
effects: For 1 hour: resistance 20 to one energy type the player picks (acid, cold, electricity, or fire) and weakness 5 to each of the other three; +2d6 damage of the attuned type on a melee weapon hit.

name: Extract Vow of Nonviolence
effects: For 10 minutes, resistance equal to floor(level/2) to all damage dealt by the one weapon that swore the vow. On a plain success the remaining duration drops by 1 minute each time that weapon hits you.

name: Feral Senses
effects: While the shape is active you gain low-light vision and imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. (Exclusive polymorph form entered with an action, so it belongs with the other battle forms in the stances registry, where senses are already supported.)

name: Fire and Iceberg
effects: For 1 minute after eating: resistance 5 to fire and resistance 5 to cold.

name: Force Shield
effects: For 1 minute (once per day): resistance 5 to physical damage. Ends early if you stop holding the shield.

name: Forge Warden
effects: While the forge warden is raised you have fire resistance 5. (Allies adjacent to you get it too, but that is their sheet.)

name: Form a Flock
effects: Up to 1 minute: 25 temporary Hit Points, and weakness 5 to area damage and splash damage while the flock surrounds you. Ends when the temporary HP are gone, the minute elapses, or you Dismiss it.

name: Fresh Produce
effects: For 10 minutes after eating the produce: resistance 2 to void damage, increasing by 2 for every 2 levels above 1st (4 at 3rd, 6 at 5th, and so on). You also cannot eat another piece while it lasts.

name: Frost Breath
effects: Resistance 5 to cold while the bottled breath is held, until you exhale it as the cone or the effect ends.

name: Galvanic Chew
effects: For up to 1 hour: resistance 5 to electricity. Ends early if you spend the Secondary Effect reaction, which makes the chew inert.

name: Geomancer Dedication
effects: One mode per self-affecting attunement, each active for 1 round after casting a matching spell: Aquatic - swim Speed equal to your land Speed (and you may use it as your land Speed on a surface); Mountain - resistance to physical damage except adamantine equal to the rank of the spell cast; Plains - temporary Hit Points equal to the spell's rank; Underground - darkvision and imprecise tremorsense out to 15 feet. Arctic, Desert, Forest and Swamp affect enemies only and need nothing.

name: Ghostcaller's Planchette
effects: Until the start of your next turn after you cast a spell by Activating the planchette: resistance 5 to all physical damage, except that attacks by incorporeal creatures and ghost touch attacks bypass it.

name: Goz Mask (Major)
effects: For 1 hour (once per day): you gain darkvision, and you ignore all concealment caused by environmental effects such as fog, rain and storms.

name: Grim Specter
effects: Up to 1 minute, once per day: you become incorporeal - immune to precision damage and to effects requiring a physical body including most diseases and poisons, and you gain resistance to all damage equal to half the relic's level, doubled against non-magical damage. Force damage, ghost touch attacks, spirit damage, void damage and vitality damage ignore this resistance. You are slowed 1 on any turn you start inside an object.

name: Grolna
effects: For 1 hour after a 1-minute onset: gain scent (imprecise) 30 feet as a new sense, and you are Stupefied 1. Stage 2 replaces it with Stupefied 2 for 6 hours.

name: Harden Flesh
effects: Until the beginning of your next turn you have resistance to physical damage (except adamantine) equal to 3, +1 at 12th level and every 4 levels thereafter, to a maximum of 6 at 20th. Requires standing on earthen or stone ground.

name: Horned Lion Amulet
effects: For 1 minute you have fire resistance 5. The triggering instance of fire damage is instead reduced by fire resistance 10, and if it was persistent fire damage you immediately attempt a flat check to end it (DC stays 10 until the persistent damage ends).

name: Iron Wine
effects: For 10 minutes your unarmed Strikes deal an additional 1d4 fire damage. A separate toggle for a second cup in one day: you gain weakness 5 to fire until your next daily preparations.
